name: الفصل لتمثيل تلفاز (الحالة 1)
description: بناء فصل يمثل تلفازًا. يجب أن يحتوي الفصل على بيانات تمثل حالة التلفاز (مشتغل او مطفأ، القناة الحالية). يجب الوصول الى حالة التلفاز او تغييرها فقط عبر طرق الحصول والتعيين (getter و setter). يجب ان يتضمن الفصل طرقًا لتغيير حالة التلفاز (تشغيل/اطفاء، تغيير القنوات). افترض ان نطاق القنوات الصالح هو من 1 الى 120 (شاملا).

comments.content: نعرّف الصنف المسمى TV1 لتمثيل تلفاز.

untr_comments.content: We want to initialize the attributes of the TV when we create an instance of the TV1 class. We do this by defining an __init__ method, which is run automatically by Python each time an instance is created. The argument (named self) is passed in automatically by the interpreter when the method is invoked on an instance of the class.

Note that Python automatically fills the first argument in with the instance object that is the implied subject of the method call. Therefore, when this method is invoked on an instance of the class, no parameter must be passed to the method.

untr_comments.content: We need to perform a test to check whether the conditions for setting the current channel of the TV to the given channel exist. The current channel of the TV could be set to the given channel only when the TV is on and the given channel is within the valid channel range. A valid range for the TV channel is from 1 to 120 (both inclusive).

The if statement tests whether the TV is on and the given channel is greater than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 120. If the TV is on and the given channel is greater than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 120, then the body of this if statement gets executed. Otherwise, the body of this if statement is skipped.
Note that the and operator yields the result True if both conditions are True.

هذه الدالة لا تملك معلمات لأن البيانات الوحيدة التي نحتاج استخدامها في هذه الدالة هي خصائص المثيل للصنف (حالة التشغيل والقناة الحالية) ويمكننا الوصول مباشرة الى خصائص المثيل من داخل طرق الصنف.
لاحظ أن بايثون يملأ الوسيط الأول تلقائيًا بكائن المثيل الذي هو الموضوع الضمني لاستدعاء الدالة. لذلك، عند استدعاء هذه الدالة على مثيل من الصنف، لا يلزم تمرير معلمة.

untr_comments.content: We need to perform a test to check whether the conditions for decreasing the current channel number by 1 exist. The channel of the TV could be decreased by 1 only when the TV is on and the current channel is greater than 1.

The if statement tests whether the TV is on and the current channel is greater than 1. If the TV is on and the current channel is greater than 1, then the body of this if statement gets executed. Otherwise, the body of this if statement is skipped.
Note that the and operator yields the result True if both conditions are True.

comments.content:
هذه العبارة تنقص رقم القناة الحالية بمقدار 1.
self هو مثيل الصنف و self.__channel يبين القناة الحالية للتلفاز. نبدأ اسم الخاصية بشرطتين سفلية (self.__channel) لمنع الوصول المباشر من خارج الصنف.
معامل النقص (-=) يطرح 1 من قيمة الخاصية self.__channel ويخزن النتيجة مرة اخرى في self.__channel. لذلك، هو مكافئ عمليًا للعبارة self.__channel = self.__channel - 1.

untr_comments.content:
This statement decreases the channel number of the TV by 1.
self is the instance of the class and self.__channel shows the current TV channel. We start the attribute name by two underscore (self.__channel) to prevent accessing the attribute directly from outside of the class.

The decrement operator (-=) subtracts 1 from the value of instance attribute self.__channel and the result is stored back into the instance attribute self.__channel. Therefore, it is functionally equivalent to the statement self.__channel = self.__channel - 1.

untr_name: The Class for Representing a TV (Case 1)
untr_description: Construct a class that represents a TV. The class should contain data that represents the TV's state (power on or off, current channel). The state of the TV could be accessed or changed only through the getter and setter methods. The class should also include methods to change the state of the TV (turn on/off, change channels). Assume that the valid channel range is from 1 to 120 (both inclusive).
